Summaries.eng: A human girl secretly raised by robots starts to uncover the dark secrets behind her lush, utopian world where humanity has all but vanished.
Summaries.jpn: 数千年後の未来を舞台に、唯一生き残っていた人間の子供を育てるロボットの物語を、「鋼の錬金術師」の入江泰浩監督と「イノセンス」の3D CGクリエイターが贈る。

Summaries.eng: A human girl secretly raised by robots begins to unveil the dark secrets of her utopian world where humanity has almost disappeared.
Summaries.deu: Ein von Robotern insgeheim aufgezogenes Menschenmädchen beginnt, die düsteren Geheimnisse ihrer utopischen Welt zu enthüllen, in der die Menschheit fast verschwunden ist.
Summaries.ara: تبدأ فتاة بشرية تربيها الروبوتات سرًا في الكشف عن الأسرار المظلمة لعالمها الفاضل حيث اختفت البشرية تقريبًا.
Summaries.pol: Dziewczynka potajemnie wychowywana przez roboty zaczyna odkrywać mroczne sekrety tętniącego zielenią utopijnego świata, w którym nie widać ludzi.

Summaries.eng: A millennium after humans vanished from Earth, two farming robots find a little human girl and start to take care of her, at great risk to themselves.
Sara's desire to go to Eden Three continues to grow, but her worried parents are dead set against it. Then, a recon squad from the city spots Sara.
After her interaction with Zurich, Sara flees Eden Three and reunites with her parents. Together, they follow a puppy-like robot to an abandoned house.
With time running out, Sara learns more about her own past, and the role Dr. Weston Fields played in creating Eden.
